name: Entity Version Workflows Example
description: Example/demo module shipping a content type, version field, workflow and settings that demonstrate Entity Version Workflows.
project_description: Example sub-module for Entity Version Workflows. On install it ships a fully wired demo: an 'Example' node type (entity_version_workflows_example), an entity_version field (field_version) on it, an entity_version_settings mapping selecting that field as the main version field, and an 'Example workflow' content-moderation workflow whose transitions are pre-configured with version rules (create_new_draft increases patch when values changed, validate increases minor and resets patch, publish increases major and resets minor). It also registers a state-backed event subscriber that can add the node title to the change-detection blacklist for testing. Intended as reference/demo and test scaffolding, not for production use.
